changelog: v0.4.3: 1) Whisper STT CPU WASM Performance Fix: eliminated WebGPU pipeline timeout on Meta Quest Browser by locking execution strictly to CPU WebAssembly (device: 'wasm') and passing explicit English transcribe parameters ({ chunk_length_s: 30, stride_length_s: 5, language: 'en', task: 'transcribe' }) to eliminate language identification overhead; 2) Subtitles & Pipeline Minimizer: added one-tap collapse/expand button on speech bubble container to minimize subtitles into a sleek floating pill for an unobstructed 360° VR view, persisting preference in localStorage; 3) Live Diagnostics & Debug Drawer: added debug toggle (🐞) with real-time timestamped event logs, active pipeline stage tracker with hang detection (>15s), latency metrics badges (STT, AI, TTS, Total roundtrip), and 1-tap clipboard export.
